scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Proves the irreducible components of the REDUCED commuting-tuple variety only, not radicality or primary decomposition of the bracket ideal. Requires characteristic zero or characteristic greater than n+1; no claim for the full characteristic-length Witt algebra. Finite enumeration supports but does not prove all-parameter assertions. The 2015, 2018 and 2021 full texts were inaccessible or not examined and equivalent coverage cannot be ruled out. Independent audit not performed.
title: Determinantal components and exact commuting-tuple counts for truncated polynomial derivations
